title: Calendar 'Connect Calendar' hides a mail + full-files grant; no status or explainer
claim: The only per-user Microsoft/Google connect is the Calendar page's 'Connect Calendar' button (CalendarPage.jsx:853-872). It redirects straight to consent that requests mail read/send and Files.ReadWrite.All (Microsoft) or Gmail read/send and full Drive (Google), per integrations.py:256-265. No explainer is shown before the redirect. Users untick scopes or abandon, and are then flagged 'needs reauth'. The header also has no connection status (provider, account, last sync, health). Fix: relabel it 'Connect Microsoft 365 / Google account', add a pre-redirect modal listing each permission and why, and add a status pill. Longer term, use incremental per-feature scopes.

title: Google Re-authorize omits account_mode; Personal Google tenants bounce to onboarding
claim: handleReauthorize (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:174-181) builds /integrations/google/connect?intent=admin without account_mode, so the backend defaults to 'workspace' (integrations.py:660-708). Personal Google tenants fail with account_mode_mismatch and land on /onboarding, so they can never re-authorize from the card. Fix: pass account_mode from info.account_type, and offer a toggle when the type is unknown.

title: Admin Connect/Re-authorize has no pre-consent explanation
claim: The Cloud provider card's Connect/Re-authorize (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:760-769) redirects straight to Microsoft/Google. It never says that a Global Administrator/super-admin is required, that this is a firm-wide grant (distinct from per-user), or that it includes send-as mail and read/write on all files. Fix: add a confirmation sheet covering plain-language access, who must approve, how to revoke, and 'Copy link for my IT admin'.

title: Matter CloudFolderCard misreports provisioning (SharePoint 'not set up', Set up always shown)
claim: CloudFolderCard computes isProvisioned = status==='provisioned' && (od || gd) (MatterDocumentsTab.jsx:161) and ignores providers.sharepoint. SharePoint-provisioned matters therefore read 'Document folders are not set up' and get no 'Open in SharePoint' link. The primary 'Set up folders' button and the 'Retry your document save after setup completes' hint render unconditionally (226-236), even for provisioned folders, which invites needless re-provisioning. The result toast has no live region. Fix: include sharepoint, render an Open link for it, show setup only when a provider is missing or failed (otherwise a secondary 'Repair folders'), and add role=status/alert.

title: Where a matter's files live is hidden in a collapsed 'Document tools' disclosure
claim: The CloudFolderCard and Synced Cloud Files, the main answer to 'where are this matter's files?', sit inside a collapsed 'Document tools' disclosure alongside portal and import tools (MatterDocumentsTab.jsx:726-767). Fix: add a persistent location strip above the list (provider icon, path, Open folder, health dot) and keep setup and sync inside the disclosure.

title: Matter upload/import accepts only local files; no OneDrive/SharePoint/Drive picker
claim: Matter Upload takes only local files, and Import takes only a local folder or ZIP (MatterDocumentsTab.jsx:774-790; MatterImportWizard.jsx:121-124). Users cannot attach a file that already lives in the firm's OneDrive, SharePoint or Google Drive, so they must download and re-upload it, which creates a second copy. Fix: add OneDrive File Picker v8 and Google Picker sources that register or copy items into the matter folder.

title: Correspondence 'automatic background capture' checkbox is a silent no-op by default
claim: The matter Rules checkbox 'Enable automatic background capture' (MatterCorrespondenceTab.jsx:161-168) saves, but nothing runs while CORRESPONDENCE_CAPTURE_ENABLED is off, which is the default (config.py:586, scheduler.py:818). Users believe matter mail is being captured when it is not. Fix: return the platform flag and last-run time with the rules payload, disable the checkbox with an explanation when capture is off, and show 'last captured X ago' when it is on.

title: Deadline sync writes every open firm matter into a user's personal calendar, bypassing matter access
claim: sync_deadlines_to_calendar (calendar_sync.py:550-567) selects every open Matter in the tenant with no matter_access_predicate. It then pushes '[LawHand] <label>: <matter_name>' events for all key dates within 90 days into the requesting user's personal Outlook/Google calendar. A non-admin who is neither owner nor assignee (matter_access.py:14-60) therefore receives the names and deadlines of matters they cannot open in LawHand, and those events persist outside LawHand. Upgraded from low because it exposes confidential matter data. Fix: default the scope to matter_access_predicate ('My matters') and allow a firm-wide option only for admins/docketing.

title: Microsoft tenants stuck at 'tier unknown' with a reconnect loop that never resolves
claim: Every Microsoft tenant shows 'Microsoft (tier unknown)', with directory sync and Teams marked 'unconfirmed / reconnect to confirm' (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:828-845). Because of the openid/profile scope defect, reconnecting never populates the tier, so admins loop on Re-authorize. Fix: add openid/profile or run the /organization backfill after connect in the backend. Until then, stop promising that reconnect will help.

title: Workspace MCP consent shows only a self-asserted client name (consent-phishing risk)
claim: The consent payload (workspace_mcp_oauth.py:496-504) returns only client.id and client.name, and WorkspaceMcpAuthorizePage.jsx:70 renders just the name. The page shows no redirect host, registration date, publisher or verification badge. When WORKSPACE_MCP_DYNAMIC_REGISTRATION_ENABLED is on (it is required for Claude/ChatGPT connectors; the default is False), anyone can register a client named like a trusted assistant with any HTTPS redirect (validate_redirect_uri only enforces the scheme). A lawyer cannot tell it apart, and one approval releases matter-read scopes. Upgraded to high for that reason. Fix: extend the payload with the redirect host and registration date, show 'Unverified app' unless the client is allowlisted, and add an admin-approved badge.

title: Unused or never-connected provider card renders as a red failure
claim: A provider that was never connected shows a red 'Disconnected' pill and every required scope as a red 'Missing' X (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:629-685, 271-280). The backend always sends required_scopes, so the friendly empty state at 822-824 never renders. A Microsoft-only firm sees the Google card as broken (the Playwright screenshot shows 8 red Missing rows), and the hub pill reads red 'No integrations connected' (223-229). Fix: render a neutral 'Not connected' card that says what connecting enables, with one Connect button, hide the scope tally, and collapse the second provider to 'Not used' once one provider is connected.

title: No per-capability controls; firms must revoke everything to disable send-as, capture or sync
claim: 'Features on this account' (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:828-851) is read-only. A firm cannot turn off send-as, mail capture, calendar write or directory sync, or limit cloud search to one provider, without revoking the whole grant. Cloud Search also shows Enabled/Disabled with no control (CloudSearchAdmin.jsx:57). Fix: add a capability switch list backed by incremental consent and backend enforcement.

title: Storage recovery CTAs send non-admins to /admin, which they cannot open
claim: The matter Cloud Files empty state calls navigate('/admin') with the label 'Connect in Admin → Integrations' (MatterDetailPage.jsx:1302-1309). The CloudFolderCard failure text (MatterDocumentsTab.jsx:219-223) and StorageReadinessNotice.jsx:30 also point to admin screens. Non-admins are redirected away, which is a dead end. Fix: make the copy role-aware. Admins get a deep link to /admin?tab=integrations&integration=cloud. Everyone else gets 'Ask your administrator to reconnect Microsoft 365' plus a copyable diagnostic.

title: Profile has no 'Connected accounts' for the user's own Microsoft/Google grant
claim: ProfilePage.jsx:276-281 lists only MCP assistant grants. Users can see and reconnect their own Microsoft/Google connection, and see what LawHand can access, only through the Calendar page, and the guide tells them to ask an administrator (16-integration-transparency.md:121). Fix: add a Connected accounts card driven by the existing GET /auth/calendar-providers data (connected, needs_reconnect, reason, missing_scopes), with the account, plain-language scopes, Reconnect and a guide link. Disconnect needs a new backend endpoint.

title: Provider cards do not disclose that firm-wide features run as the connecting admin's account
claim: The Google card says 'Firm-wide connection' and 'restore email, calendar and document access for the firm' (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:623-626, 720-725; OnboardingWizard.jsx:446-448). That implies org-wide mailbox access, but the grant covers only the connecting admin's own Gmail, Drive and Calendar. For Microsoft, 'Granted by' never renders because service_account_email is never set (715-726). Admins cannot see whose mailbox, calendar and OneDrive power tenant fallback, or that removing that user breaks storage. Fix: populate the identity (openid or GET /me after connect) and show 'Firm-wide features run as <upn/email>', with a note that each attorney connects their own account.

title: Cloud Search hub card promises a search boundary control that does not exist
claim: The Cloud Search hub card's setup step says 'Confirm the permitted site, drive, or mailbox boundary' (IntegrationsHub.jsx:86-100), but no such control exists and search falls back to the admin's mailbox. Fix: until a boundary control ships, show which account each provider search runs as, and warn when tenant fallback is active for non-admin users.

title: Failed admin re-authorize after onboarding lands on the onboarding wizard
claim: The OAuth callback always redirects admin-intent errors to /onboarding (integrations.py:1790-1807), even when onboarding is finished. Success goes to /admin?tab=integrations (1765-1772). The error is never shown next to the card that was re-authorized. Fix: mirror _post_connect_redirect and send errors to /admin?tab=integrations&integration=cloud&error=..., then render the mapped message on the ProviderCard.

title: Onboarding OAuth error banner maps only 3 codes, one naming the wrong provider
claim: OnboardingWizard.jsx:35-39 has copy for only three error codes, and one of them names Google for a Microsoft failure. access_denied, consent_required, interaction_required, invalid_state and oauth_failed all fall back to 'could not be completed'. Fix: add per-code, per-provider copy (for example consent_required: 'Your Microsoft 365 Global Administrator must approve LawHand') with a copy-link action.

title: Login shows a generic failure for admin-approval-required or cancelled consent
claim: loginErrors.js:15-35 has no message for 'your organization's admin must approve LawHand' or 'you cancelled'. Every unknown code becomes 'Sign in did not complete.' Fix: map provider error codes in the backend, then add consent_required/admin_approval_required and access_denied messages with a 'send this link to your IT admin' helper.

title: SharePoint documents are labelled 'Local' / 'Open in Local'
claim: storageLabel() (MatterDocumentsTab.jsx:67-72) handles google_drive, onedrive and cloud only, so SharePoint files read 'Local' and 'Open in Local'. Row links also use the stored cloud_url instead of the fresh /documents/{id}/open redirect. Fix: add a SharePoint case, route Open through /open, and offer Download next to Open for cloud files.

title: Upload toast invites cloud edits that later break LawHand downloads and e-sign (409)
claim: After upload, the toast says 'Edits happen in the firm's cloud copy' (MatterDocumentsTab.jsx:440-444). Those cloud edits are exactly what later make LawHand downloads and e-sign fail with 409, because there is no general adopt-edits flow. Fix: warn that cloud edits must be brought back into LawHand, or drop the invitation until adopt-edits exists.

title: Draft workspace points to a 'Refresh edits from cloud' button it does not contain
claim: In office-snapshot mode, DocumentDraftWorkspace.jsx:168-175 tells users to 'use Refresh edits from cloud', but that button exists only on the proposal card or panel behind the modal (ActionProposalCard.jsx:615). 'Open cloud working copy' does not say whether it opens Word or Google Docs. In text mode, a LawHand save sits next to the cloud link with no warning that Word edits will be overwritten. Fix: add Refresh to the workspace aside, add provider-specific Open buttons, and warn before a text save.

title: Primary storage selector hides the risk that OneDrive means the admin's personal drive
claim: The primary provider selector options 'Auto (Microsoft 365 → OneDrive)' and 'Microsoft OneDrive' (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:360-380) give no warning that matter files will live in the connecting admin's personal OneDrive. The root_ownership at_risk signal appears only in onboarding. Fix: show the root_ownership badge and detail next to the selector, recommend SharePoint, and mark OneDrive 'personal drive – at risk'.

title: SharePoint library binding is unverified, forced primary, unlabeled and ID-based
claim: Saving a SharePoint library always sends is_primary: true (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:480-492). The backend marks health 'configured' without a test write (cloud_admin.py:381-411), although readiness copy says 'Choose and verify' (storageReadiness.js:82-89). The site search input has only a placeholder (530-535), the folder is hard-coded to root '/' (489-491), and the button reads 'Save SharePoint binding'. Fix: add a label, a folder browser, a 'make primary' choice, and a Verify step that writes and deletes a probe file, and use plain copy such as 'Use this library for matter documents'.

title: Document storage disclosure stays collapsed when storage is not ready
claim: The amber 'Matter document storage is not ready' block is inside a Disclosure whose defaultOpen is false (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:286-298; ui.jsx:317-331), so admins do not see the blocking state. Fix: set defaultOpen={!storageReadiness.ready} and show the next action on the summary line.

title: Storage migration panel exposes raw enums and IDs and has no confirm on Abandon
claim: StorageMigrationPanel.jsx:126-141 shows the phase as a raw enum (for example awaiting_confirmation), requires free-text Root folder ID and SharePoint drive ID, lists unresolved items as object_type and object_id with no matter name, and runs Abandon without a confirm. Fix: map phases to human-readable steps, show matter numbers and names, confirm Abandon, and later replace the ID fields with a folder picker.

title: Cloud documents lack an 'Open in Word/Docs' action; icon links are unlabeled
claim: Cloud documents offer only a generic 'Open' (mobile) or 'Open in OneDrive' web link (MatterDocumentsTab.jsx:1139-1147). There is no desktop 'Open in Word' (ms-word:ofe|u|) or 'Edit in Google Docs', and the icon-only open and delete links in the table rely on title alone (1406-1419). Fix: add Open in Word with Open in browser as secondary, route both through /documents/{id}/open, and add aria-labels.

title: Linking a cloud folder requires pasting URLs or IDs under a tab named 'File Shares'
claim: Remapping a matter's cloud folder requires pasting a provider URL or raw Folder ID (MatterSmbSharesTab.jsx:470-490), in a tab named 'File Shares' that reads as SMB (MatterDetailPage.jsx:1849). Fix: rename the tab to 'Storage & folders' and use the OneDrive/SharePoint and Google folder pickers, keeping paste as a fallback.

title: Document preview supports only PDF; DOCX and cloud files get a download link only
claim: MatterDocumentPreview.jsx:8-23 previews only PDFs. DOCX and cloud-hosted files get only a Download link. Fix: embed the Graph driveItem preview for OneDrive/SharePoint and /preview for Drive, with an Open-in-Word/Docs action.

title: Correspondence scan defaults to Outlook regardless of connection and hides the target mailbox
claim: The matter Correspondence provider select defaults to 'Outlook / 365' (MatterCorrespondenceTab.jsx:559), so Google-only users hit 'Connect or reconnect Microsoft 365' on their first scan. The select has no label (613-621), the panel never says which mailbox is scanned, scan failures are text only with no Reconnect (591-593), and the toasts and participant filter (641-653) lack a live region or label. Fix: default to the connected provider from /auth/calendar-providers, show 'Scanning <mailbox> (<provider>)', and add labels, role=status/alert and a Reconnect link.

title: Two divergent 'sync email' flows (Communications vs matter Scan now)
claim: The Communications scan (CommunicationsPage.jsx:478-493) matches on sender only, stores no .eml and runs an LLM. The matter 'Scan now' (MatterCorrespondenceTab.jsx:581-597) matches parties and case numbers and archives the .eml. Each blocks the other's deduplication, so the same mail captures differently depending on the entry point. Fix: offer one 'Capture mail' flow with a single result model, and present triage as a view on captured mail.

title: Matter email composer has no CC/BCC
claim: Attachments now exist (ComposeEmailModal.jsx:141), but CC and BCC do not (PARALEGAL_UX_REVIEW.md:199-218). Correspondence copied to a supervising attorney must go out through Outlook or Gmail directly, so the matter record is incomplete. Fix: add CC/BCC to the connected-mailbox send path, or offer 'Create draft in Outlook/Gmail'.

title: Composer hides which mailbox sends and gives no send confirmation or reconnect path
claim: ComposeEmailModal.jsx:84-103 has no 'From' line, so users cannot tell whether mail goes from their Outlook/Gmail, a firm mailbox or LawHand SMTP. On success the modal just closes (MatterDetailPage.jsx:2407-2414). The error (line 142) is not role=alert, and a reauthorization error has no Reconnect button. Fix: show 'Sends from: <provider> (<address>)', show a toast with result.provider after sending, and add role=alert and a Reconnect CTA.

title: External calendar events only load for now to +30 days
claim: Outlook and Google events are fetched only for now to +30 days (calendar_sync.py:83, 101-102), so past weeks and later months show no external events, and the 5-minute poll (CalendarPage.jsx:610-624) re-reads the same window. Fix: pass the visible range to /calendar/sync (or a read-only events endpoint) per view.

title: Deadline sync reports success while dropping failed pushes
claim: The success toast counts only created deadlines (CalendarPage.jsx:759-762). Failed pushes are dropped silently (calendar_sync.py:626-634), so a total failure reads 'Synced 0 deadline(s)' as a success. Fix: return a failed count with reasons and show a partial-failure state.

title: Calendar sync banner is not announced, and a 424 failure offers no Reconnect
claim: The sync success/error banner (CalendarPage.jsx:877-906) is a plain div with no role or aria-live. A 424 failure (763-772) clears the provider without setting reconnectProvider, so no inline Reconnect appears. Fix: add role=status/alert and set reconnectProvider on 424.

title: Teams personal tab is only a launcher that opens browser tabs
claim: TeamsTabPage.jsx:29-50 shows no matter content inside Teams. Matters and Calendar open new browser tabs (target=_blank). Fix: show 'My matters and upcoming deadlines' inline and use Teams deep links or stageView.

title: Teams channel tab ignores the linked matter and shows the generic page
claim: The channel tab config sets contentUrl to the generic /teams page and ignores entityId=matterId (TeamsTabConfigPage.jsx:71-77), so every channel tab shows the same firm-wide list. Fix: point contentUrl at a per-matter view and read the channelId from app.getContext().

title: No in-product guidance to install the Teams app or Office add-in
claim: The Teams admin panel (TeamsPanel.jsx:149-190) and the rest of the product never explain how to install the LawHand Teams app or Office add-in. That guidance exists only in repo docs. Fix: add an 'Install in Microsoft 365' section with package and manifest downloads and Integrated Apps steps.

title: Teams personal tab shows auth/permission errors as an empty channel list
claim: getTeamsLinks failures are caught and rendered as an empty 'Linked channels' list (TeamsTabPage.jsx:9-14), so auth, framing and 403 errors look like 'no channels'. Fix: add a distinct error state with retry, a sign-in or open-in-browser fallback, and separate handling for 403.

title: Teams panel offers an impossible 'Reconnect' when Teams is unavailable for the tenant
claim: TeamsPanel gates only on /integrations/status teams_connected and ignores capabilities.teams (TeamsPanel.jsx:124-145). For personal Microsoft accounts, or when TEAMS_FEATURE_ENABLED is off, it shows 'Reconnect to enable Teams', which can never succeed, while the hub pill says 'Not available on this account' (confirmed in a screenshot). Fix: when capabilities.teams is unavailable, show a 'not available' card with the reason and no reconnect button, and say 'not enabled for this deployment' when scopes are complete.

title: Teams gate says 'Connect Microsoft 365 first' with no button
claim: TeamsPanel.jsx:129-136 tells the admin to go to 'the Integrations tab' but offers no action, although the hub card invited 'Set up' (IntegrationsHub.jsx:401). Fix: add a button that calls onSectionChange('cloud') or starts connect with &teams=1.

title: Office pane Propose stays enabled on read-only hosts or an empty selection (server 422)
claim: The Propose button (office-addin/src/main.ts:43-46) is enabled in Outlook read mode and when the Word selection is empty, which produces a server 422. Fix: gate it on capabilities.writeEnabled and selection charCount, and explain inline why it is disabled.

title: Office pane errors show raw HTTP and internal codes
claim: Sign-in exchange failures show only '(403)' and drop the server detail such as 'identity is not linked' or 'not enabled' (officeSession.ts:95-97). Apply failures show '(word_write_failed)' or '(range_shape_mismatch)' (main.ts:149). Fix: parse the detail and map codes to actionable copy (link your Microsoft account, ask your admin to enable the pilot, re-select the range, the document is protected).

title: Office pane has no Retry after sign-in fails or the session expires
claim: When sign-in fails or the session expires (main.ts:188-196) there is no Retry or Sign in button, so the user must close and reopen the pane. Fix: add a Retry sign-in button and re-run session.ensure automatically on 401.

title: Office pane request is a blank textarea with no suggested actions or scope explanation
claim: The request form (office-addin/index.html:37-44) is an empty textarea with no per-host quick actions, and nothing explains the one-action limit or what the pane can change. Fix: add host-specific quick actions and a line describing what the pane can change.

title: Excel preview renders before/after as raw JSON matrices
claim: The Excel adapter (excelAdapter.ts:84-85) shows before and after as monospace JSON (styles.css:36), so changed cells and formulas cannot be scanned. Fix: render a small cell grid with changed cells highlighted and formulas marked.

title: Word preview shows two full text blocks with no inline diff
claim: The Word preview (main.ts:69-93) shows before and after as full text blocks, so small wording changes in a long clause are easy to miss before applying. Fix: show a word-level redline diff.

title: Office pane never shows or lets the user choose a matter
claim: The pane (office-addin/index.html:25-56) has no matter chip or picker, so users cannot tell whether firm or matter knowledge is used (it is not). Fix: add a matter picker suggested from the file name, sender or document properties, and pass it to the backend.

title: MCP setup guidance omits Microsoft Copilot and Gemini Enterprise
claim: The Platform MCP setup (MCPPage.jsx:144, 205-216) covers only Codex/ChatGPT, Claude and OpenCode. It never mentions Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or Gemini Enterprise, not even as 'not yet supported'. Fix: add cards marked 'Pilot, not yet certified' with the requirements and a contact CTA.

title: MCP hub card is operator-only, buried under Advanced, and promises admin client approval that does not exist
claim: The 'MCP servers' hub card (IntegrationsHub.jsx:217-240) has audience 'operator' and sits under Advanced (34-43), so firm admins asking 'can we use our own AI assistant?' will not find it. Its copy ('Approved external assistants', 'Approve the exact assistant client') implies an admin approval control, but approval is per-user consent. Fix: add a firm-audience 'Connected AI assistants' card with the enablement state and a link to per-user connections, keep policy operator-only, and correct the approval copy.

title: MCP consent error does not say which scope or role is missing
claim: When the requested scopes exceed the user's allowed set, the router raises 'Your current LawHand permissions do not allow the requested access' (workspace_mcp_oauth.py:491-495) with no list of blocked scopes, missing role or next step. Fix: return the blocked scopes and required role, and offer downscoped consent.

title: AI settings show a jargon LiteLLM alias field with no processing disclosure or BYOK UI
claim: Admin > Settings > Advanced shows firm admins only a 'LiteLLM Gateway / Standard alias override' free-text field (AdminPage.jsx:1343-1370). Nothing shows which provider or region processes firm data, and the existing BYOK API (api.js:916-920) has no UI callers. Fix: add an 'AI processing' card (route, provider, region, retention, allowed data class) and a guided bring-your-own Azure OpenAI/Vertex flow with a live test.

title: Chat tool results return relative links that are dead inside external assistants
claim: Tool handlers return relative links such as '/firm-memory?...' and '/api/documents/{id}/download' (chat_tools/handlers.py:260), which are unclickable in Copilot, Gemini and Claude. Fix: build absolute FRONTEND_URL links for matter, task, review and document views in every tool result.

title: Missing-scope state is hidden: capability badges say 'Available' and there is no remedy banner
claim: 'Features on this account' shows Email, Calendar and Storage as 'Available' even when missing_required contains Mail.Send, Calendars.ReadWrite, Files.ReadWrite.All or Gmail, Calendar or Drive scopes (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:828-850; capabilities.py:169-171). In health=missing_scopes no banner names the affected features, and Re-authorize is styled as a secondary button (760-769). The unusable-health banner covers only revoked/refresh_failed. Fix: map missing_required to badge states ('Declined at consent – re-grant'), add an amber banner listing the missing permissions in plain language, and make Re-authorize primary.

title: Microsoft and Google cards have no Disconnect despite existing backend endpoints
claim: The provider cards offer only Connect/Re-authorize (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:760-770), although POST /integrations/microsoft/disconnect and /integrations/google/disconnect exist (integrations.py:2105, 2137) and the legal notice promises a disconnect. api.js has no wrappers for them. Nothing explains that Microsoft grants persist until the Entra enterprise app is removed. Fix: add Disconnect with a consequence confirmation (including the removal of per-user connections) and links to Entra Enterprise applications and myapplications. Purging indexed data needs backend work.

title: Per-user remedy 'open Calendar and choose Connect Calendar' misrepresents the grant
claim: The admin per-user connections row (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:780-793) tells users to 'open Calendar and choose Connect Calendar'. That grant also covers reading and sending the user's mail, read/write on all their files, mail capture and search (integrations.py:256-259). On mobile the button text is hidden, leaving only an icon. Fix: rename it to 'Connect Microsoft 365 / Google account', list what it enables, and point to a Profile > Connected accounts entry.

title: Sync now ignores the job id, waits 4s, and shares one spinner across providers
claim: Sync now (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:114-126) discards the returned job_id (scheduler.py:158-171), waits a fixed 4 seconds, and uses one 'syncing' state for both provider cards, so failures never appear. Fix: poll /api/sync/documents/jobs/{id} (document_sync.py:152-165) and show counts or the error on the correct card.

title: Recent sync-run tiles show raw slugs and a green 'completed, 0 ok' on silent failure
claim: The recent-run tiles (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:796-810) show raw job slugs such as 'cloud-sync' and 'correspondence-capture'. They show green 'completed, 0 ok' even when the provider silently failed (cloud_sync.py:361-372), and only 3 runs are listed. Fix: use readable job names, a warning style when a completed run has 0 items after earlier non-zero runs, and a link to full history.

title: Cloud panel ignores ?connected=/?error= after an OAuth return
claim: IntegrationsPanel.jsx:145-158 never reads the connected, error or provider query params, so a successful reconnect gives no confirmation and errors are visible only in the address bar (the docs say so at 04-integrations.md:47). ZoomPanel.jsx:89-105 already handles these params. Fix: reuse the ZoomPanel logic to show a banner and strip the params.

title: Connection state is scattered across surfaces despite the 'one place' promise
claim: The hub hero (IntegrationsHub.jsx:427-429) promises one place, yet Microsoft 365/Google state appears in the onboarding cards, the hub pill, the ProviderCard, Cloud Search status (CloudSearchAdmin.jsx:66-99), the Teams gate and the Calendar 'Connect Calendar' button. Assistant grants live in Profile, and Office add-in/Teams app deployment appears nowhere. Fix: make Cloud the single source of truth, have other surfaces show a status chip that links to it, and add 'Office apps' and 'AI assistants' cards.

title: Inconsistent names for sections, providers, verbs and health states
claim: The section is called 'Cloud accounts & storage', 'Cloud', 'Settings > Integrations' and 'Integrations tab' (IntegrationsHub.jsx:66-67; TeamsPanel.jsx:133). Providers appear as lowercase keys capitalised by CSS (CloudSearchAdmin.jsx:72, 95, 367). The action is 'Re-authorize', 'Reconnect' or 'Connect Calendar', and health reads 'Missing Scopes' (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:615-621, 768, 787). Fix: adopt one glossary (Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace / Personal Google; Reconnect; 'Missing permissions').

title: Raw provider errors and Graph scope names shown to firm admins
claim: Raw provider errors such as '400 invalid_grant Token has been expired or revoked.' are shown in red monospace (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:739-748), and the Teams gate lists raw Graph scope names (TeamsPanel.jsx:267-271). Fix: map errors to a plain sentence plus one action, and put the raw text under 'Technical details for support'.

title: Capability reasons are tooltip-only and badges have no inline action
claim: Each capability's reason is only a title tooltip (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:843), which keyboard, touch and screen-reader users cannot reach, and the 'Error' and 'Reconnect needed' badges have no inline action. Fix: render the reason as visible helper text with a Reconnect or Learn more link per row.

title: Hub pills say 'Needs attention' without a cause, and Cloud Search contradicts Cloud
claim: The Cloud pill (IntegrationsHub.jsx:46-52) does not name the provider or the problem and ignores storage readiness. Cloud Search says 'Available' while Cloud needs attention (106-110). Fix: label the pill with the cause and derive Cloud Search from the same state.

title: Firm-facing hub cards list operator-only prerequisites and point to hidden 'Advanced'
claim: Firm-facing hub cards list operator prerequisites such as 'Approved OAuth redirect URLs and application credentials' (IntegrationsHub.jsx:76-80, and Zoom at 175-179), which firm admins cannot act on (IntegrationReadinessCard.jsx:15-20). The refresh_failed remedy points to 'Advanced', which many admins cannot see (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:625). Fix: rewrite them as firm actions and say 'contact LawHand support' when the user lacks manage_integrations.

title: Integrations hub navigation and tabs lack ARIA semantics and focus management
claim: The hub nav buttons (IntegrationsHub.jsx:466-471) lack aria-current, and switching sections unmounts the card so focus falls to body (519-541). The TeamsPanel and Cloud Search tabs have no tablist/tab/aria-selected (TeamsPanel.jsx:192-207; CloudSearchAdmin.jsx:577-592), the TeamsPanel spinner has no role=status, and the readiness card renders nothing while loading. Fix: add aria-current, move focus to the section heading, use proper tab semantics with arrow keys, and add role=status loaders.

title: No per-capability 'last worked' health; run error summaries dropped
claim: The provider card shows only directory-sync and token-refresh times (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:726-738). It has no last success for mail capture, calendar push, storage writes or the search index, and error_summary from recent runs is dropped (796-810). Fix: add a per-capability 'Last worked' row with the failure reason and Retry, backed by run data.

title: Zoom Disconnect and 'Clear tenant app' fire with no confirmation
claim: ZoomPanel's Disconnect and 'Clear tenant app' (ZoomPanel.jsx:108-119, 134-145, 164-176) act immediately with no consequence text, while QBOPanel uses useConfirm (QBOPanel.jsx:146-147). Fix: standardise on ConfirmProvider with a consequence sentence and reuse it for the Microsoft/Google disconnect.

title: Integrations hub hero headline renders dark-on-dark (invisible)
claim: The hero h2 'Every external connection, in one place.' (IntegrationsHub.jsx:428) inherits text-brand-ink from the global h1-h6 rule (index.css:15-18) on a bg-brand-ink panel, and the class on the h2 does not override it. It is invisible, as confirmed in a Playwright screenshot. Fix: add text-white to the h2.

title: Backend reconnect errors send non-admins to the admin-only Integrations page
claim: connected_mail._reconnect_detail (connected_mail.py:233-239) and microsoft_mail.py:34-36 tell users to 'Reconnect ... in Integrations', which is admin-only (integrations.py:1817-1819, admin.py:1640). The user's own connect lives on the Calendar page. Fix: point the messages at a per-user connections destination (see U14) and change the backend copy.

title: Chat 'Cloud context active' notice names all providers regardless of what is bound
claim: The matter Chat notice (MatterDetailPage.jsx:1809-1815) always names OneDrive, SharePoint and Google Drive, and appears whenever any tenant credential exists. It misstates what the AI can read for this matter. Fix: list only the providers in matter.cloud_folder and hide the notice when none are bound.

title: Prepare document after save: raw provider name and 'Download' only
claim: After Save to matter, PrepareDocumentBody.jsx:461-477 shows the backend value raw ('in google drive', 'onedrive') and offers only 'Download saved document', even when the file went to OneDrive, SharePoint or Drive. Fix: add 'Open in Word for the web' / 'Open in Google Drive' links via /api/matters/{m}/documents/{id}/open and map the labels.

title: Word output must be downloaded to review; Save tooltip is misleading
claim: For editable Word output, users are told to download and open the DOCX to check pagination (PrepareDocumentBody.jsx:461-465), and there is no in-app rendering. The Save tooltip says 'Download and review the current Word preview' although no download is required (390-398). Fix: add a PDF rendition or an embedded Office/Drive preview, and correct the tooltip.

title: Templates can only be uploaded from local disk; no cloud source link
claim: Template upload (TemplatesPage.jsx:838-851) accepts only local drops. There is no OneDrive, SharePoint or Drive import and no link back to the source library, so revising a template means download, edit and re-upload (300-305). Fix: add picker imports and show the source with 'Open source in Word'.

title: Prepare output is PDF or Word, never both
claim: The output format choice (PrepareDocumentBody.jsx:328-352) is either/or. 'PDF for signature' keeps no editable DOCX, and a Word output cannot be sent for signature later without a manual export. Fix: save both, or add 'Convert to PDF' on a saved DOCX.

title: invalid_grant remedy always says 'revoked' with no Testing-mode or password-change hint
claim: The unusable-health remedy (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:623-626) always reads 'The provider has revoked this grant' for invalid_grant (token_vault.py:83-87). It never mentions a Google OAuth app in Testing mode (7-day refresh expiry) or a password change. Fix: when the error is invalid_grant and the grant is less than 8 days old, suggest the Testing-mode cause and contacting support.

title: Google sign-in forces a consent screen on every login
claim: Google login sets prompt=consent and access_type=offline for basic scopes, then discards the refresh token (auth.py:1553-1566), so users see a consent screen every time. Fix: use prompt=select_account without offline access, and add include_granted_scopes=true.

title: Teams enable copy omits the Chat.ReadWrite and TeamsActivity.Send grants
claim: The 'Enable Microsoft Teams' gate (TeamsPanel.jsx:138-145) describes the re-consent as 'channel and messaging access'. The grant also includes Chat.ReadWrite (all of the admin's 1:1 and group chats) and TeamsActivity.Send, neither of which is used. Fix: list the exact permissions and purposes, and drop the unused scopes in the backend.

title: Scope labels understate the breadth of Sites.Read.All and Files.ReadWrite.All
claim: The scope detail labels (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:18-30) say 'Access SharePoint sites' for Sites.Read.All (every site collection) and 'Read & write files (OneDrive + SharePoint)' for all files the admin can reach. Fix: use Microsoft's consent wording and add a 'why LawHand needs this' line per scope.

title: Task drawer pending-document panel lacks 'Open cloud copy' and always shows 'verified'
claim: TaskBoard's pending document panel (TaskBoard.jsx:895-913) offers 'Refresh edits from cloud' but no way to open the cloud copy. Its storage state is derived on the client and shows 'verified' until approval fails (line 1064). Fix: add 'Open in Word/Drive' and a drift indicator computed on the server.

title: Cloud Files panel shows cryptic 2-letter provider boxes and raw provider keys
claim: The matter overview Cloud Files panel shows f.source.slice(0,2) ('DR', 'ON', 'SH') (MatterDetailPage.jsx:1323-1331), and the Documents tab shows raw 'microsoft / onedrive' (MatterDocumentsTab.jsx:758-760). Fix: use provider icons and names plus the modified date.

title: Dead 'Cloud Drives' tab and ConnectedFilesModal stub
claim: FileUpload's Cloud Drives tab (FileUpload.jsx:207-221) and ConnectedFilesModal are never enabled. The modal lacks role=dialog and has an unlabeled close button (ConnectedFilesModal.jsx:48-61), and cloud import progress would be hidden because the upload list renders only on the local tab (line 176). Fix: delete them, or finish them on real pickers.

title: Correspondence scan result hides its 7-day / 50-message window
claim: The 'Scan now' result (MatterCorrespondenceTab.jsx:586-589) does not say it checked only the last 7 days and the 50 most recent messages, so users assume older mail was checked. Fix: state the window and link the forwarding alias for older mail.

title: Communications toolbar always shows the Outlook and Gmail scan buttons
claim: The Outlook and Gmail scan buttons (CommunicationsPage.jsx:610-627) show even when that provider is not connected, and errors fall back to the raw key ('Failed to sync microsoft email.', line 489). Fix: show only connected providers (or disable the others with guidance) and use readable names.

title: Cloud Search admin: cramped fixed grids, alarming token expiry, duplicate and jargon actions
claim: The provider and sync-result grids in CloudSearchAdmin (lines 66, 364) are fixed at 2 columns and cramp on phones. 'Token expires' shows the hourly access-token expiry (81-86). 'Sync Metadata Now' (345) duplicates 'Sync files + email' (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:255), and 'Invalidate Cache' has no busy state or confirm (348-352). Fix: use responsive grids, show connection health instead of token expiry, name it 'Refresh search index', and rename the cache action to 'Clear cached search results' with a confirm.

title: Teams tab config: unlabeled selects and '[object Object]' errors
claim: The Team, Channel and Matter selects on TeamsTabConfigPage (141-167) use placeholder options instead of labels, and an object error detail renders as '[object Object]' (line 80) because the page does not use teamsErrors.errorText. Fix: add labels and use errorText().

title: Teams tab config 'permissions required' is a bare Connect; non-admins silently redirected
claim: 'Teams permissions required' (TeamsTabConfigPage.jsx:128-137) shows a Connect button with no explanation of scopes or who must consent, and non-admins are silently redirected away (App.jsx:352). Fix: explain the admin-consent requirement and show an 'Ask your LawHand admin' state to non-admins.

title: Office pane brand mark reads 'WP' instead of LawHand 'LH'
claim: The task pane header (office-addin/index.html:13) shows 'WP', while the product mark is 'LH' (ProductPage.jsx:219). Fix: use the LawHand mark or icon.

title: Outlook capture button says 'Use current selection' but captures the whole item
claim: In Outlook the 'Use current selection' button (office-addin/index.html:32) captures the whole item (subject and body, possibly the thread). Fix: label it per host ('Use this email' / 'Use this draft') and show the body length and a thread warning before capture.

title: Office pane ignores the Office dark theme
claim: styles.css:1-6 hardcodes a light palette, so the pane is bright white in dark-mode Outlook and Word. Fix: read Office.context.officeTheme or prefers-color-scheme into color tokens.

title: Office pane's live region on the whole main re-announces the preview
claim: aria-live='polite' on <main> (office-addin/index.html:11) combined with role=status on #status (line 58) makes screen readers repeatedly announce the entire preview. Fix: keep the live region only on #status.

title: Captured Office context goes stale silently until apply
claim: The context card (main.ts:105-116) does not track selection or item changes, so the capture goes stale silently and surfaces only as 'stale' at apply time. Fix: listen for DocumentSelectionChanged/ItemChanged and show a Re-capture prompt.

title: Ribbon icons at 16/32/80 px all point to one 96x96 PNG
claim: word-excel.xml:92-94 and outlook.xml:72-74 map the 16, 32 and 80 px icons to the same 96x96 PNG, so ribbon icons look blurry and fail Marketplace validation. Fix: ship correctly sized and high-DPI icons.

title: MCP scope label 'Draft client email proposals' also covers SMS
claim: The consent scope label in workspace_mcp_oauth.py:46 mentions only email drafts, but the scope also covers SMS proposals. Fix: relabel it 'Draft client email and SMS proposals for review (never sent automatically)'. This is a backend label.

title: MCP activity panel shows raw scopes, client IDs, UUIDs and hashes
claim: WorkspaceMcpActivityPanel.jsx:44-61 shows raw scope strings (unlike the grants panel's normalized labels, WorkspaceMcpGrantsPanel.jsx:124, 131), the raw client_id, reviewer UUIDs and SHA hashes inline. Its buttons are unstyled underlines with no type (34, 45, 48), and the error copy is generic (29). Fix: reuse normalizeWorkspaceMcpScopes, show names, and move hashes into Audit evidence.

title: Google card is always titled 'Google Workspace', even for Personal Google
claim: The provider card title (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:274-283) is fixed at 'Google Workspace'. Only a small account_label chip distinguishes Personal Google, while onboarding names the tier correctly (OnboardingWizard.jsx:430-432). The directory-sync row still shows for personal tiers. Fix: title the card from account_type and hide the directory-sync row for personal accounts.

title: Per-user connections row gives counts only, with no names or nudge
claim: The per-user row (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:780-792) reports only counts ('N need to ... Connect Calendar'). It does not list who, what is missing, or offer a way to remind them. Fix: add an expandable per-user list (health, missing scopes) with a 'Send connect link' action.

title: Operator readiness card omits Google service-account, publishing and verification status
claim: The Google readiness check (IntegrationReadinessCard.jsx:4-13) covers only the client ID and secret. It does not cover GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY, OAuth publishing status (Testing or Production), the scope tier, or verification/CASA status, although Entra has a verification command. Fix: add these checks and an operator checklist.

title: Onboarding 'Personal Google / Google One' label implies Gemini/Google One matters
claim: The onboarding option is labelled 'Personal Google / Google One' (OnboardingWizard.jsx:446-453), which implies that a Google One (Gemini) subscription does something in LawHand, contrary to the recorded decision. Fix: label it 'Personal Google account (Gmail)' and state that LawHand does not use Google One or Gemini subscriptions.

title: Onboarding Microsoft card lacks a work-account warning; SharePoint missing; emojis announced
claim: The onboarding Microsoft card (OnboardingWizard.jsx:404-421) does not warn that personal Microsoft accounts are unsupported (18-cloud-provider-support.md:23-25). SharePoint is not offered at storage setup (545-548), decorative emojis are not aria-hidden (350-353), and the button says 'Set up later' where the docs say 'Skip setup'. Fix: add a 'work or school account' note, aria-hide the emojis, align the naming, and later add SharePoint.

title: Draft basis always says 'No template attached', even for template drafts
claim: DocumentDraftWorkspace.jsx:148-151 always shows 'No template attached' because MatterDocumentDraftAction has no template_name, and TaskBoard.jsx:1301 reads a field that does not exist, even though template_id and title are in request_payload. Fix: carry the template id and title on the action and show the name and version.
